summary: Dr. Thomas J. Dailey, eye, ear, nose and throat specialist in Plymouth, Pennsylvania; John's 1st cousin 4 times removed.
bio:
Thomas Joseph Dailey was born on 5 March 1884 at Avondale in Plymouth Township, Pennsylvania, the son of William Dailey and Nora Connole, which makes him John's 1st cousin four times removed. He qualified as a physician at the University of Pennsylvania in 1909 and practised in Plymouth as an eye, ear, nose and throat specialist.

He registered for the draft during the First World War and married in Luzerne County on 27 November 1917. Dr. Dailey died at Plymouth on 7 May 1934, aged fifty.
